prompt: Create an original 180 second deep instrumental house instrumental composition for rest, unwinding and breathing exercises. Mood: peaceful, soft, spacious. Instruments: warm synth chords, four-on-floor drums, sub bass. Style: consistent dance groove, small filter movement, no large drop. Tempo approximately 106 BPM; F major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use a restrained arrangement, soft attacks, no sudden accents. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A chill, electronic track with a steady, driving beat. It features warm synth pads, a plucked synth melody, and a prominent synth bassline, creating a relaxed yet rhythmic atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首轻松的电子音乐，带有稳定而富有驱动力的节拍。它以温暖的合成器铺底、拨弦合成器旋律和突出的合成器低音线为特色，营造出一种放松而富有节奏感的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
